# OVATION

Ovation provides event video production and live streaming. Based in Ljubljana, Slovenia. The website presents concerts, festivals, conferences, aftermovies and corporate/promotional video.

## Pages
- [Slovenian homepage](https://ovationav.si/)
- [English homepage](https://ovationav.si/en/)
- [Event filming](https://ovationav.si/storitve/snemanje-dogodkov/)
- [Live streaming](https://ovationav.si/storitve/prenos-v-zivo/)
- [Concert filming](https://ovationav.si/storitve/snemanje-koncertov/)
- [Conference filming](https://ovationav.si/storitve/snemanje-konferenc/)
- [Live streaming in English](https://ovationav.si/en/services/live-streaming/)
